title: mobench.yml
description: Target/engine declaration for the mobench generic engine benchmarking core.

engine.description: Framework adapter id (add new engines by registering an adapter).

adb.description: Path to adb; required when type=adb

device_id.description: adb device serial; required when type=adb

required_cmake_args.description: CMake -DKEY=VALUE flags that mobench run verifies against CMakeCache.txt in the build tree.

output.description: Override llama-bench JSON output flag (e.g. '--json' for legacy builds).

backend.description: Backend label recorded into benchmark records (e.g. 'cpu', 'metal').

n_repeat.description: Inner repeat count (-rep) passed to MNN llm_bench.

dir.description: optional model directory (MNN LLM legacy dir) holding path's config + weights; synced as a dir on adb

cache_type_k.description: KV cache K quantization type (-ctk) passed to llama.cpp tools.

cache_type_v.description: KV cache V quantization type (-ctv) passed to llama.cpp tools.

flash_attn.description: Flash-attention setting (-fa) passed to llama.cpp tools.

cli_args.description: Extra CLI flags passed verbatim to the engine benchmark tool.

env_control.description: Environment-control master switch; 'none' skips governor, CPU pinning and frequency locking.

cpu_pin.description: Bind the measurement to a CPU set via taskset (default true). Failure aborts the run.

oneOf.description: Range or CSV list, e.g. "4-7" or "4,5,6,7".

pin_cpus.description: Explicit CPU set; null = auto-detect from the thread count, preferring whole cpufreq clusters.

lock_freq.description: Pin the cpufreq policies covering the selected CPUs to the performance governor (default true). Failure degrades to a labelled warning.

cooldown_c.description: Optional pre-run cooldown target temperature in Celsius (hottest thermal zone).

cooldown_max_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait during the pre-run cooldown gate.

cooldown_per_round.description: Wait until cooldown_c before every individual round instead of once before the run.

max_attempts.description: Maximum execution attempts per round when the engine exits non-zero or times out.

timeout_s.description: Per-round command execution timeout in seconds.

freq_floor_mhz.description: Optional post-round minimum CPU frequency threshold in MHz; lower readings mark freq_audit.valid=false.

log_checks.description: Regex probes run over each round's raw log (forbid aborts immediately; missing expect flags log_audit).

power.description: Reserved documentation flag indicating power analysis intent.

thermal.description: Reserved documentation flag indicating thermal monitoring intent.

validation.description: Precision-validation instruments (mobench validate). Absent = no validation capability; a declared section must name at least one instrument.

prompts.description: Prompt files for the greedy instrument (token-stream comparison over the single-token decode path).
